caseNameFull: Wetzel v. Fulton, Superintendent of Banks of Ohio
attorneys: Messrs. Merritt A. Vickery and William K. Gardner for appellant. Mr. Luther Day and Mr. John W. Bricker, Attorney General of Ohio, with whom Messrs. Donald W. Kling and George H. Rudolph were on the brief, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal herein is dismissed for the want of jurisdiction: (1) Lynch v. New York ex rel. Pierson, ante, p. 52; (2) Gibbes v. Zimmerman, 290 U S. 326, 332.
